narrative.headline: 2018 Ram 2500: service brakes dominate owner complaints
narrative.summary: Across 2,460 owner complaints to NHTSA, service brakes are the most-reported area by a huge margin at 2,229 reports (91%), far ahead of the electrical system (457, 19%) and hydraulic (380, 15%). The service brakes reports include 27 crashes and 2 injuries, the most of any category. No fires or deaths are reported in any category.

issues.title: Service Brakes
issues.blurb: By far the most-reported area: 2,229 complaints (91%), with 27 crashes and 2 injuries, the most of any category. One owner describes the truck failing to stop under hard emergency braking, especially when towing downhill.
